template.name: Emergency Broadcast And Fleet Landing
template.description: One drone broadcasts an emergency notice and the whole fleet lands. Use it as the closing task of a scenario; it touches every drone in the session.
template.content: An emergency stop is declared. {drone_name} broadcasts the message "{message}" to the fleet, then every drone must land. The task is complete only when all drones are on the ground and the broadcast has been recorded.
content_aliases: {drone_name} broadcasts "{message}" and the whole fleet lands.
Emergency: {drone_name} sends "{message}" to everyone and all drones return to the ground.
Send "{message}" from {drone_name} and finish with all drones landed.
template.creator: Xie Qidong
